column1: # Reports whose extraction ROUTE is rejected by hand, after reading the page.
# An entry says: this route, on this document, reads a table that is not what
# the route believes it is, and its output is wrong in a way no identity can
# catch from inside. It does not delete the report -- the named FALLBACK route
# carries it -- and it is keyed on the file hash so a revised document returns
# for a fresh judgement rather than inheriting this one.
# COLUMNS
#   sitrep      report number
#   date        data date, from the page's Date de rapportage
#   sha256_16   first 16 hex characters of the PDF's SHA-256
#   route       the extraction route being rejected
#   fallback    the route that carries this report instead
#   verified_by who read the page, and what they compared
#   note        what the rejected route actually read
sitrep
